technologies.label: Radio telescope
technologies.description: A huge telescope that detects very weak radio waves from distant sources.

technologies.label: Xray telescope
technologies.description: X-rays are blocked by most atmospheres. This powerful telescope is designed for space where atmosphere is not a problem.

technologies.label: Thermodynamics facility
technologies.description: Undertakes processes that involve temperature extremes. Can also perform basic thermal processes, such as smelting.

technologies.label: Spaceship docking clamps
technologies.description: Allows you to place docking clamps so that spaceships can anchor to a specific location by matching up clamp locations. Automation requires "Anchor using" and "Anchor to" signals fed into the console.

technologies.label: Supercharger
technologies.description: Can charge up to 64 robots at a time at high speed. Structure max power draw is 1GW.

technologies.label: Teleportation
technologies.description: Unlocks other teleportation technology. This technology does nothing on its own but is a gateway to other technologies.

technologies.label: Vitalic acid
technologies.description: A strong cocktail of various acids.

technologies.label: Vitalic epoxy
technologies.description: An incredibly strong bio-sourced epoxy with regenerative properties.

technologies.label: Vitalic reagent
technologies.description: An efficient multi-purpose reagent for a wide range of chemical reactions.

technologies.label: Rocket fuel from pyroflux
technologies.description: The energy contained in pyroflux is powerful enough to make rocket fuel.

technologies.label: Wide area beacon
technologies.description: 15 module slots at 50% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 7.5. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 14 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating.

technologies.label: Wide area beacon 2
technologies.description: 20 module slots at 50% transmission efficiency for a maximum module power of 10. Transmits the effects of modules to nearby friendly entities within 14 tiles. Multiple beacons affecting the same entity will overload it and prevent it from operating.

technologies.label: Deep space zone discovery
technologies.description: Search for interesting areas of deep interstellar space. Asteroid fields can have a lot of unique and valuable resources.

technologies.label: Zone discovery
technologies.description: Search for planets, moons and asteroid belts using telescopes.

technologies.label: Targeted zone discovery
technologies.description: Search for planets, moons and asteroid belts that have specific resources. Select resources preference in Informatron > Zone discovery.

technologies.label: Shield projector
technologies.description: Creates a protective force field. More energy is required when the projector is charging or when the shield takes damage. Can block enemy projectiles if the "Combat Mechanics Overhaul" mod is installed. Toggle shield with [KEY-CODE-NOT-DEFINE-IN-HEADLESS-MODE].

technologies.label: Centrifuge
technologies.description: Processes various recipes for material enrichment or refinement.

technologies.label: Steam turbine
technologies.description: Generates electricity from higher temperature steam, such as from a heat exchanger (continous power) or an electric boiler (energy storage).

technologies.label: Portable fission reactor
technologies.description: Inserted into armor to power other equipment.

technologies.description: Provides power for equipment modules.
